item.subject: op:strategy.harvest()
item.text: Harvested want is added to totalLocked and released linearly over lockDuration (1 day by default, 0 with harvestOnDeposit), so the share price rises gradually after a harvest; yield that has not been harvested yet is not in the price, so deposits made just before a harvest share in it.
